description: The places the commercial employer-plan EOB mails to: the ten lexicon places (referenced by city and ZIP; a test checks they agree with src/generate/lexicon.js). Every place is in a county that is not on the November 2023 CLAS list, so no language tagline (29 CFR 2590.715-2719(e)) is required; a test and the release check refuse a place in a listed county.

clas.note: For each state of a place, the FIPS ids of the counties the list names in that state (2020 Census county codes, read 2026-11-20 from www2.census.gov/geo/docs/reference/codes2020/cou/); a place whose countyFips is listed, or in a state not stored here, is refused.

countyNote: Each place's county is the US Census Bureau geocoder's county (benchmark Public_AR_Current, vintage Current_Current, layer Counties) at the city's downtown point inside the ZIP, read 2026-11-20; countyFips is its GEOID. The county is that of the address the EOB uses.
